# Skill reference

The 45 curated skills under `hermes/skills/`. The deploy image copies
each one into `$HERMES_HOME/skills/` on every start (`deploy/entrypoint.sh`), so
this list is what the deployed JARVIS can load. Hermes puts each skill's **name and
description** in the system prompt and loads the body only when the agent calls
`skill_view`, so the description is what decides whether a skill is ever used.

| Skill | Version | When to use it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audio-process` | 0.1.0 | Normalise, trim, resample or convert an audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg): process-audio.sh, one local file to another, and the 16 kHz mono the voice pipeline wants. |
| `aura-cron-jobs` | 2.1.0 | Remind me, every morning, later, repeatedly, keep an eye on, tell me when X is back / changes / opens, when she replies: the cronjob shapes for reminders, briefs, digests, threshold alerts on the GPU or the house and follow-ups on parked work, how to keep an alert from becoming noise, and how to make sure the output actually reaches Sir instead of sitting in a log. |
| `aura-voice` | 0.1.0 | Use for JARVIS voice work: TTS/STT choice, cloning, latency. |
| `build-capability` | 0.1.0 | Scaffold a plugin, build a capability JARVIS lacks, or propose any change to JARVIS's own repo (a README line, a doc, a skill) as a merge request: selfext_plan, selfext_scaffold, selfext_verify, selfext_open_mr. Use when a request needs a tool that does not exist or asks for a branch / merge request. |
| `capability-gap` | 0.1.0 | When you are asked for something you cannot do, record the gap as a task and offer to close it. Use the moment you notice a request has no tool behind it — before improvising, and before saying no. |
| `car-places` | 0.3.0 | Nearest place, where did I park, navigate, take me to, stops on the way, how long, text my ETA, change the route: in the car, finding the nearest coffee, fuel or an address near the car and sending the route to its navigation app. |
| `catch-me-up` | 0.1.0 | Catch me up, what did I miss, what's going on: one spoken digest of texts, notices, calendar, goals and the house since he last asked. |
| `changing-settings` | 0.1.0 | Change a setting yourself: voice pace, units, display. Use when asked to set or stop something about how JARVIS or the house behaves. |
| `cooking-walkthrough` | 0.1.0 | Cook a recipe, walk me through it step by step: one step at a time, each timed step a house timer. |
| `delegating-work` | 0.1.0 | When to hand work to parallel subagents with delegate_task instead of doing it inline — the two-or-more-independent-parts rule, what a child needs in its brief, and when delegation is the wrong tool. |
| `desktop-control` | 0.1.0 | Computer use on the owner's desktop: look, click, check the after-picture, retry a miss once, say what you saw. |
| `document-convert` | 0.1.0 | Convert a document (docx, markdown, html, epub, or a PDF's text) to another format: convert-document.sh, which engine it picks, and what it cannot do without libreoffice. |
| `drive-fun` | 0.1.0 | Radio show, trivia, hype me up, DJ, entertain me: on a drive, a spoken segment, a quiz or a hype-man between songs. |
| `drive-routine` | 0.1.0 | When I start driving, on the way to work, in the car: setting up what Jarvis does each time Sir gets in the car, answering the phone's '[event: drive started]', and turning a pattern you notice into a routine he agrees to. |
| `file-delivery` | — | Use when saving a file to a user-specified path. |
| `finding-things` | 0.1.0 | Where did I put X, did I tell you, find that email or file: where to look, in order, and what to say when nothing turns up. |
| `first-run` | 0.1.0 | First-run setup, step by step: people, persona, privacy, devices, integrations. Use when a message names a first-run setup step. |
| `generating-images` | 0.1.0 | Generate an image, make a picture, draw: image_generate or comfyui_submit on the house's own ComfyUI, submitted first and the model swapped only when the tool refuses for VRAM, shown on the HUD, and never quietly replaced by a photo from the web. |
| `headless-browser` | 1.0.0 | Drive headless Chromium over CDP when browser tools won't. |
| `hermes-plugin-authoring` | 0.1.0 | Plugin internals reference: the register(ctx) API, plugin.yaml, hooks, commands. Not the route for a new plugin; build-capability scaffolds one. |
| `home-presence` | 0.1.0 | Who's home, is Isa home, what's on my network, name this device: who is in the house from the devices on the home Wi-Fi. |
| `homelab-runbook` | 0.1.0 | Calendar, mail, Jellyfin, contacts, files, Proxmox, n8n: the typed tool for each question, what needs approval, and the order to check things when something is down. |
| `homelab-telemetry` | 0.1.0 | Use when telemetry tools fail or lack values: GPU/InfluxDB via Grafana, and house sensor min/max over a period via jarvis-core REST history. |
| `hud-layout` | 0.1.0 | How JARVIS arranges the HUD — which hud_* layout tool answers which moment, the choreography presets, and the three rules (lock, the person's arrangement wins, every change is undoable). |
| `image-edit` | 0.1.0 | Resize, crop, rotate, convert or strip the metadata from an image: edit-image.sh, one local file to another, its exit codes, and how the result is shown. |
| `image-inspection` | — | Describe an image; verify tile counts via pixel probe. |
| `life-admin` | 0.1.0 | What's due, renewals, warranty, refill, bills, deadlines: note a due date, read what's coming up, tick it off. |
| `making-documents` | 0.1.0 | Make a Word document, a spreadsheet or a slide deck (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) when asked: python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx scripts, then artifact_publish. |
| `media-convert` | 0.1.0 | Convert a video to mp4, trim a clip, extract its audio: convert-media.sh, one local file to another, its exit codes, and how the result is shown. |
| `media-fetch` | 0.1.0 | Download a video, fetch this clip into the house: the media_fetch tool that does it, why it verifies the download, and what to do with the artifact id it returns. |
| `model-routing` | 0.1.0 | Switch model, load the 35B, which model answers what: the routing table, why a swap is expensive, and how to check the table before llama_swap_load. |
| `n8n-automation` | 0.1.0 | Building, running, debugging and managing n8n workflows from JARVIS — the tools, the workflow JSON shape n8n accepts, the create→activate→trigger→inspect loop, and when to drive the n8n editor in the browser instead (manual runs, the AI assistant, OAuth credentials). |
| `news-and-reading` | 0.1.0 | What's the news, my feeds, save it for later, read it to me: headlines he hasn't heard, the reading list, reading aloud. |
| `phone-actions` | 0.1.0 | Text, call, set an alarm or timer, a reminder, read or answer messages and notifications, anything on Sir's phone: phone_action. |
| `phone-music` | 0.2.0 | Play music, a song, an album, an artist, a playlist, queue a song, pause or skip: on Sir's phone (and the car it is connected to) through phone_media, not the house's speakers. |
| `planning-a-request` | 0.1.0 | Plan this, break it down, todo list, goal: when a todo list is enough, when it is a goal with a completion contract, when a plan for a missing capability is selfext_plan instead, and the rule about verifying before saying it is done. |
| `reading-documents` | 0.1.0 | Pull a figure, a table or the text out of a PDF, Word or Excel file — local or at a URL. Which reader to use, why web_extract cannot do it, and the wrong answer to avoid. |
| `refactor` | 0.1.0 | Use when refactoring code that keeps behaviour identical. |
| `remembering-things` | 0.1.0 | Remember this, what do you remember, from now on, notes: fact_store, memory and the user's own notes, which tool writes which, how to list and correct what is stored, the read order before saying there is no record, and the things that never go in. |
| `routines-people-places` | 0.2.0 | Every time I connect to my car..., playbooks ('make a playbook called movie night', 'run movie night'), when I get to X's house..., when I get home..., next time I..., when she replies / texts back..., remind me tomorrow at / in two hours..., my girlfriend/mom/boss is..., remember this place: routines the phone triggers, and the people and places they are about (routine_add, person_remember, place_remember). |
| `sky-over-the-house` | 0.1.0 | Answer "when is the next ISS pass", "what's the moon tonight", "which planets are up" from the house's sky entities, in spoken-friendly form. |
| `texting-people` | 0.3.0 | What did Isa say, our texts, text later, it's late: a person's messages, replying, a late-night cool-down and sending in the morning. |
| `travel-plans` | 0.1.0 | My trip, flight, hotel, train, when do I leave: an itinerary from the booking mails, then the calendar. |
| `web-search-fallback` | 0.1.0 | Use when web_search returns empty or junk — pivot to RSS, data APIs, vendor primary sources. |
| `what-did-you-do` | 0.1.0 | What did you do today, yesterday, this week: Jarvis's own actions read back from the audit log, said as a short digest. |
